A few useful answers.

What do you build?

I'm Satyarth Mishra, an AI/ML engineer and creative technologist based in Greater Noida, India. I build with computer vision, edge AI, digital products and visual storytelling.

Which technologies do you use?

Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, FastAPI, Raspberry Pi and ESP32, alongside web and 3D design tools.

Which projects can I try online?

Agri Sarthi and Suraksha One have public live demos linked on the Projects page. Other entries describe prototypes, source-based work or hardware projects.

Can I browse without the 3D experience?

Yes. These About, Projects, FAQ and Contact pages work without WebGL and provide their main content without JavaScript.

How can I contact you or find your résumé?

Use the Contact page or email mishrasatyarth61@gmail.com. The résumé is available as a downloadable PDF.
